Writes typed code and added navigation types, but PRs show guided review fixes on typing and loose types remain.
Maintains fastlane lanes and the release train with review; the lead owns the pipeline design.
About 60 reviews a year, mostly short but a few catch native-module issues.
Wrote and kept updated the release checklist with rollback steps; one solid page.
Wires crash reporting breadcrumbs; no dashboards or alert design.
